strongest_changes: The garden sequence turns the focus from an abstract threat into a staged mechanism in which subjects advance their own plan while result outruns recognition.
The immediate extension-strategy-firmness sequence makes delay itself the active track of the taking rather than empty postponement.

summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several coexisting mechanics beyond a generic punishment reading: stepwise testing, failed performance, enfolding, social circulation, unread marks, smooth accommodation, accruing liability, and becoming the very tale one denied. Branch-distant textile, fostering, race-delay, and yield images remained live but explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The taking root supports path, degree, enclosure, extinction, fostering, and gestational branches; the packet does not force one spatial or material realization.
The garden sequence strongly models delayed recognition, but whether it supplies the causal mechanism of 68:44 or only a preceding analogy remains open.
The interception in 68:49-50 limits universal claims of mechanical inevitability, but the focus syntax does not extend that rescue path to the deniers.
The smooth-road, textile, fostering, race, and yield activations are structurally productive yet remain form-distant exploratory analogies.
